Step 3: Connect Your Domain to Hosting

 

Once your domain name is registered, you need to connect it to your hosting server.

You can do this by simply updating your DNS.

  1. Firstly, you need to Namecheap login using your Namecheap email account.
  2. Then, click on the Domains tab and select manage next to the domain you would like to navigate to your site.
  3. Furthermore, Scroll to the Nameservers section and select Namecheap Web Hosting DNS and save it by clicking the tick icon.
  4. Then, go to “Addon Domain” from the Domains section and add an add-on domain.
  5. Enter your domain name and give a subdomain.

You can pick any subdomain you want, it doesn’t matter really.

Thus, you will link your domain to the cPanel of the package.

 

Step 4: Access cPanel

 

You will receive an email containing your cPanel URL, username, and password after creating your hosting account.
It is completely different from your Namecheap account username and password.

  1. You need to log in with the given username and password and access your cPanel. cPanel is the dashboard of your hosting account server, in which you can send or transfer files for your website.You can install different software and content management systems like WordPress on your website.
  2. Furthermore, you can create email accounts, manage email settings, and spam protection.

Moreover, you can check website statistics and manage the database.

 

Sign Up with Namecheap

 

Step 5: Install WordPress Using Softaculous

 

  1. After linking your domain to cPanel click on “Go to cPanel“.
  2. Once you log in to your cPanel, go to “Softaculous Apps Installer“. Furthermore, select WordPress from there and click on install now.
  3. Then, choose the latest version of WordPress and an installation URL. You need to provide your domain’s URL there.
  4. Then, set your site’s name and description.
  5. Also, set the admin username and password along with email addresses. You can install add-ons and select a theme if you want.
  6. Lastly, click on install and it will take about 30 seconds to complete.

 

Step 6: Build Your Website

 

  1. After installing WordPress, go back to cPanel and click on “Namecheap SSL“. Now click on installed via Namecheap SSL.There you can see whether your domain’s SSL certificate is ready or not.If it shows in progress then wait till it shows an active sign.SSL certificate allows getting HTTPS on your website. Also, it keeps your data secure between servers, and even helps your Google SEO ranking.
  2. When your website’s SSL certificate is ready, go to your website’s WordPress by using-https://your domain name/wp-admin.
